title: Kth element of 2 sorted arrays
statementHtml: Given two sorted arrays a and b of size m and n respectively. Find the kth element of the final sorted array.
examples:
Input: a = [2, 3, 6, 7, 9], b = [1, 4, 8, 10], k = 5

Output: 6

Explanation: The final sorted array would be [1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10]. The 5th element of this array is 6.
constraintsHtml:
• 1 <= m, n <= 104
  • 0 <= arr1[i[, arr2[i] < 109
  • 1 <= k <= m+n
